verification: Each selected official wheel matches uv.lock SHA-256. Each registry crate archive matches the SHA-256 in that wheel SBOM. Standalone documents are preserved verbatim; embedded notices are exact unmodified byte ranges, with full source-member SHA-256 and offsets recorded. Repository fallbacks use commits from the verified crate .cargo_vcs_info.json and Git-tree-verified blobs. No downloaded code was executed.
scope_note: This is a bounded notice supplement for the registry components identified by these selected wheel SBOMs, not a general legal audit or proof that every listed crate or source file is linked into the binary. SBOMs can include build-only, feature-disabled and other-target components. Their notices are included conservatively rather than asserting that all components are bundled. Alternative upstream license texts are retained as published; their inclusion does not elect every alternative. Workspace components retain the Python distribution license. Future wheel versions or platforms require a fresh check.
selection_note: Preserves standalone LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE/COPYRIGHT documents, AUTHORS and UNLICENSE, plus identified embedded copyright-and-permission notices in crate C/Rust/assembly source. API implementation files such as objc2-foundation/src/copying.rs are not legal notice files. No runtime code, model weights, or dependency versions are changed.

workspace_components.name: tokenizers
workspace_components.license_source: The Python distribution license (installed wheel or existing upstream LICENSE supplement) covers these workspace crates; no registry-archive hash is supplied by the SBOM.

repository_fallback.reason: The crate archive omits standalone license files. .cargo_vcs_info.json in the SHA-256-verified crate pins this upstream commit. Git blob SHA-1s were checked against the complete, nontruncated official Git tree at that commit.
